headline: Ready for review: consuming texture paths validate linear source spans before use; the disclosed OpenGL Morrowind result remains a performance flag.
scope: Candidate 2e801ab07c4a8d0a87defd2ba70ddad3b3e1041c is measured against parent 37823ccf18263764c82ceb6698201330a22a6c65. PGR2 values are means of two 60-second ABBA runs per build and renderer. Morrowind values are means of two matched 10-second snapshot runs per build and renderer; all cadence values are NV2A display-write rates, not rendered FPS. Direction changed between Morrowind pairs; the body calls Vulkan neutral and retains the OpenGL cadence reduction as a flag without attributing it to the patch.
